rail.label: Rail
rail.description: The narrow column of section icons on the far left.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.description: The pages of the current area, as a collapsible tree, a flat list or not at all.

menuBar.label: Menu bar
menuBar.description: File, Edit, View, the app's menus, then Help, along the top.

statusBar.label: Status bar
statusBar.description: The current item's state on the left and small facts on the right, along the bottom.

bottomPanel.label: Bottom panel
bottomPanel.description: A panel under the work area for output, problems or a terminal.

documentTabs.label: Document tabs
documentTabs.description: Open pages stay in one row of closable tabs.

commandPalette.label: Command palette
commandPalette.description: Control K opens a searchable list of commands.

theme.label: Default theme
theme.description: The theme a new visitor sees. System follows the device setting.

density.label: Density
density.description: Compact for tools, comfortable for reading.

dashboardHome.label: Dashboard home
dashboardHome.description: Open on a Dashboard of real numbers. Off unless the app has numbers worth showing.

siteNavigation.label: Navigation
siteNavigation.description: The site's pages in a top bar, or in a sidebar beside the reading column.

siteFooter.label: Site footer
siteFooter.description: Every page ends with a footer that links to all of the site's pages.

headerSearch.label: Header search
headerSearch.description: A search button in the header.

headerButton.label: Main header button
headerButton.description: One main button in the header, such as Subscribe.

app.label: App frame
app.description: Choices for the App frame: Web app, Desktop app and Document editor.

presets.label: Web app
presets.description: A browser tool with a rail, a sidebar tree and a command palette.
presets.madeFor: Made for browser tools and dashboards people keep open all day.

presets.label: Desktop app
presets.description: A Windows tool with a rail, a sidebar list and a Status bar.
presets.madeFor: Made for Windows utilities that do one job well.

presets.label: Document editor
presets.description: An editor with a Menu bar, a Status bar, a bottom panel and closable document tabs.
presets.madeFor: Made for editors that open, change and save documents.

presets.label: Website
presets.description: A reading site with a header, a footer, a reading column and a theme toggle.
presets.madeFor: Made for blogs, article sites and documentation.
